Every proposal checked by computation (all code rerun with numpy/pandas, numbers recomputed): 1 accept, 6 accept with a smaller edit, 24 reject; at least 13 of 31 would have made a lesson wrong (e.g. the dividend factor, a seed changed without new output, 17.66 called 17.68)

Consequence: proposals stay the default; apply=true is not safe with this corrector, and a proposal whose code output no longer matches should be rejected in code
